name: Registration for Crop Procurement
benefit: - Enables farmers to sell their produce at government-approved procurement centers. - Ensures fair pricing through the Minimum Support Price (MSP) announced by the government. - Provides a transparent and digital platform for registration and sale. - Payment for the procured crop is made directly to the farmer’s bank account through online transfer.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. - The applicant should be a landholding farmer. - The applicant should intend to sell their crop at a government-designated procurement center.
